attestation: I visually inspected every page of the exact 84-page PDF identified above through ten contact sheets and inspected representative front matter, dense mathematics, editorial notes, and back matter at full resolution. This is actual rendered-page inspection rather than inference from pixel metrics. No release-blocking visual defect was found.

criteria.notes: All 84 pages were reviewed through contact sheets, with representative front matter, dense mathematics, editorial notes, and back matter also viewed at full resolution. No text, mathematics, image, note, or source marker is clipped.
No collision among body text, displays, footnotes, source anchors, page numbers, images, or editorial-note boxes was observed.
Accented names, primes, radicals, continued fractions, subscripts, superscripts, and witness formulas render legibly without missing-glyph boxes.
Dense continued fractions, group-theoretic displays, corrected interval formulas, and the Tannery witness relation remain readable.
Portraits, ornaments, printer mark, section rules, component seams, and note boundaries render consistently without unintended raster or seam defects.
Pages 41, 79, 82, 83, and 84 are the five declared blank-topology pages. No other blank page and no black or dark-surprise page was observed.
The historical translation remains visually primary. Editorial notes use descriptive headings and ordinary prose, with stable IDs confined to small reference lines.
Source-coordinate labels, front-matter numbering, historical pagination, and terminal topology are consistent and unobstructed.

observations: The title, human-facing edition name, and exact R2 DOI are clear and balanced.
